correctness.rationale: For C=phi_w∘B the regular full fiber is the simple zero set. Partial fractions show C' lies in the finite span of the normalized Bergman kernels, including the possible zero at the origin. Minimal-norm Gram interpolation gives ||C'||²=v*G^{-1}v/(1−|w|²)²; proper degree-d change-of-area gives ||C'||²=d. Thus H on the fiber has the unique eigenvalue d. For degree two, source/target automorphisms reduce B to z² and weighted composition U_Bf=√2 z f(z²) has exactly odd functions as range. A two-kernel difference is odd iff z2=−z1 (distinct), so equality occurs precisely on a full fiber; strict positivity off-fiber follows from the known semidefinite inequality. Exact independent rational inverse-Gram checks verified three real-zero fibers of degrees 2, 3, 4; those tests are supplementary.
